page.overview:
Who is Queen of Clubs?

The Queen of Clubs is a character in the fictional Grimm Fairy Tales pastiche universe, who first appeared in 2013 in issue #13 of the 1st volume of Wonderland. The character was created by Patrick Shand & Raven Gregory. Despite the name of her home universe, the character is inspired by characters from the Alice's Adventures in Wonderland and Through the Looking-Glass, and What Alice Found There books by Lewis Carroll, and not the fairy tales compiled by the Brothers Grimm.

The origins of the Queen of Clubs is unknown. The Queen of Clubs and the Queen of Diamonds are lovers, and enemies of the Queen of Spades. After their most recent battle with her, they finally became free of Wonderland, retreating to Los Angeles, California.
